title: [AAPS3.0_beta2] NSClient - io.socket.engineio.client.EngineIOException:xhr poll error - Seems to have also broken Nightscout
symptom: After installing NSClient 3.0 beta2, the user sees io.socket.engineio.client.EngineIOException:xhr poll error in logs, and the Nightscout site goes down. Reinstalling NSClient and manually entering credentials allows syncing but eventually crashes the NS site again; data appears in history viewer but not on the main graph.
cause: The thread speculates that the NS API is overwhelmed by NSClient's sync/upload load, possibly because the free Heroku dyno cannot keep up; developer MilosKozak added an option to slow down NS upload, implying upload rate is a factor.
fix: Users report downgrading to NSClient 2.8 resolves the issue; developer added an option to slow down NS upload (commit ae399f0bf5b40d81905dac979aba1153baede364).
evidence_quote: i added option to slow down NS upload
